login.title: Login ya Mufarisani wa Tshiṱirathedzhi
login.welcome: Ro ṱanganedzwa! Sign in u langa vharangaphanḓa vhaṋu.
login.heroTitle: U alusa bindu ḽaṋu ḽa zwa dzinnḓu nga vhurangaphanḓa vhuṅwe na vhuṅwe vhune na vhu ḓisa .
login.heroIntro: Portal nthihi ya u ṅwalisa vharengi na vhafhaṱi, u vhulunga tshirunzi tsha vharangaphanḓa vhaṋu na u vha tevhela u swika kha u buka.

register.title: Redzhisiṱara vharangaphanḓa nga mithethe
register.text: Kha vha rumele khasiṱama yavho na phurojeke ine vha vha na dzangalelo khayo.

protect.title: Tsireledzo ya vhuvhili
protect.text: Lead yaṋu i dzula i yaṋu lwa tshifhinga tsha tsireledzo, ngauralo a hu na muṅwe muthu ane a nga ṱoḓa khasiṱama i fanaho.

track.title: Tevhelani vhuimo vhuṅwe na vhuṅwe
track.text: Vhonani tshiimo tsha murangaphanḓa muṅwe na muṅwe na ḓivhazwakale yo fhelelaho, u bva kha vhukwamani ha u thoma u swika kha u buka.

handover.title: Tshikolodo tsha u buka
handover.text: Musi khasiṱama i tshi ṅwalisa, lead i ṋekedzwa mufhaṱi na iwe wo rekhodiwaho sa mufarisani wa tshisima.

login.secure: U dzhena ho tsireledzeaho - zwidodombedzwa zwa vharengi vhaṋu zwi dzule zwi zwa tshiphirini
login.builderLink: Kha vha saine kha portal ya vhafhaṱi

signup.title: U Ṅwalisa Mufarisani wa Tshiṱirathedzhi
signup.intro: Kha vha ite akhaunthu yavho u thoma u ṅwalisa na u langa vharangaphanḓa vhavho.
